summary.result: The results show that the susceptibility maps generated by the FR and CNN-GWO models display comparable spatial patterns, with area under the curve values of approximately 78.11% and 80.11%, respectively.
summary.background: The study area features steep mountain slopes characterized by Neogene sedimentary lithology, overlain by Quaternary loess deposits, and is affected by intensive mining activities, making it highly susceptible to seasonal landslides.
summary.method: The FR model assessed the statistical correlation between landslide occurrences and individual influencing factors, whereas the CNN-GWO model integrated allrasterlayersto identify complex spatial patternsin landslide susceptibility.
